blast_radius.functions_impossible_without_n8n: None proven. Legacy webhook forwarding and legacy external ingest delivery specifically require n8n, but equivalent repository direct generation and internal ingest exist.
blast_radius.consumers_beyond_seo: No executable non-SEO n8n consumer was found. GPT Chat, Javob, Tahlil, Agents/Sotuvchi, public site and unrelated admin functions have no n8n runtime import.
blast_radius.synchronous_production_requests: Admin run, scheduled-run, topic-plan launch and Yandex quick-launch can synchronously wait for n8n only when the legacy flag selects the bridge. Production flag values are unknown.
blast_radius.jobs_lost_on_immediate_shutdown: Any active external n8n execution, enabled GitHub scheduler call routed to legacy mode, and direct legacy ingest delivery would fail. Exact live jobs are unknown.
blast_radius.n8n_can_write_github: Unknown for the uninspected live n8n workflow. No repository call path grants the legacy bridge or ingest endpoint a GitHub write; the only identified repository writer is a separate admin-authenticated draft import endpoint.
blast_radius.n8n_can_auto_publish: Unknown for the uninspected live n8n workflow. The repository ingest path always stores pending_review and has no publish call.
blast_radius.missing_ingest_token: When legacy ingest is explicitly enabled, missing/empty/misconfigured binding returns 503 before body parsing. With the default disabled switch it returns 404.
blast_radius.raw_logging: No endpoint logging was found; persistence exceptions are now returned as a generic error and tests assert no credential or malformed payload is logged/echoed.
